dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:1601.text: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 狂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1602.text: Stupid or foolish. Formed from 言, with 疑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1603.text: To mislead one another. Formed from 言, with 𥈀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1604.text: To slander, 𧩂. Formed from 言, with 山 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1605.text: To disparage. Formed from 言, with 幾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1606.text: To impose a false accusation. Formed from 言, with 巫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1607.text: To slander, 𧩂. Formed from 言, with 非 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1608.text: To defame. Formed from 言, with 㫄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1609.text: To deceive, 詶. Formed from 言, with 壽 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 醻. The Book of Zhou says: “Let none fabricate deceptions to create illusions.”

shuowen:1610.text: To deceive, 譸. Formed from 言, with 州 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1611.text: To curse or invoke against, 詶. Formed from 言, with 且 indicating the sound. [The cross-gloss is uncertain.]

shuowen:1612.text: The action called 詶, apparently cursing or deceiving. Formed from 言, with 由 indicating the sound. [The cross-gloss is uncertain.]

shuowen:1613.text: To part and separate. Formed from 言, with 多 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 跢 in the Analects' “My foot shifted.” King Jing of Zhou built the Yi Terrace at Luoyang.

shuowen:1614.text: Disorder. Formed from 言, with 孛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1615.text: Disorder. Another explanation: to put in order; another: unceasing. Formed from 言 and 絲.

shuowen:1616.text: Error. Formed from 言, with 吳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1617.text: To mislead. Formed from 言, with 圭 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1618.text: A word expressing dislike. Formed from 言, with 矣 indicating the sound. Another explanation: the manner 誒然. The Spring and Autumn commentary says: “誒誒, out, out!”

shuowen:1619.text: Pain. Formed from 言, with 喜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1620.text: A full, bold voice raised above others. Formed from 言, with 自 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 睞 in “glaring at one another.”

shuowen:1621.text: 謧詍: much speech. Formed from 言, with 离 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1622.text: Much speech. Formed from 言, with 世 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Do not chatter so.”

shuowen:1623.text: To express one's mind without considering it. Formed from 言, with 此 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Gathering together in slander.” [The opening gloss is uncertain.]

shuowen:1624.text: Words passing back and forth. Another explanation: an infant not yet able to speak correctly; another: to invoke in prayer. Formed from 言, with 匋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1625.text: 𧧛𧧛: much speech. Formed from 言, with 冄 indicating the sound. Lelang has a Ranhan county.

shuowen:1626.text: Words opposing one another. Formed from 言, with 遝 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1627.text: The contradictory speaking called 䜚誻. Formed from 言, with 沓 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1628.text: Disputatious speech, 詽詽. Formed from 言, with 幵 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1629.text: The appearance of forceful speech. Another explanation: repeatedly becoming angry with one another. Formed from 言, with 巂 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 畫.

shuowen:1630.text: The sound of foolish speech. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 勻 indicating the sound. Xicheng in Hanzhong has a Hong township. Also pronounced like 玄.

shuowen:1631.text: Clever, facile speech. Formed from 言, with 扁 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: “Sharp and adept at clever speech.” The Analects says: “Befriending the glib and flattering.”

shuowen:1632.text: To match. Formed from 言, with 頻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1633.text: To inquire or approach, as when seeking a wife one first makes connected inquiries. Formed from 言 and 口; 口 also indicates the sound. [The wording is uncertain.]

shuowen:1634.text: To investigate one another in speech. Formed from 言, with 兒 indicating the sound. [The expression 誽司 is uncertain.]

shuowen:1635.text: To call and entice one another. Formed from 言, with 兆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1636.text: To add. Formed from 言, with 曾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1637.text: To forget. Formed from 言, with 失 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1638.text: To shun or be wary of. Formed from 言, with 其 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: “Those above are not wary of evil conduct.”

shuowen:1639.text: Extravagant or false speech. Formed from 言, with 敢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1640.text: Extravagant or boastful speech. Formed from 言, with 夸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1641.text: Extravagant words. Formed from 言, with 延 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1642.text: Extravagant or boastful speech. Formed from 言, with 萬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1643.text: To jest. Formed from 言, with 虐 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Good at play and jest.”

shuowen:1644.text: A hostile or twisted look. Formed from 言, with 𥃩 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1645.text: Disruption or interruption, 䜋. Formed from 言, with 工 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Pests and thieves cause disorder within.”

shuowen:1646.text: To stop midway. Formed from 言, with 貴 indicating the sound. The Methods of the Sima says: “When the army is numerous, people halt.” 䜋 means to stop.

shuowen:1647.text: A sound. Formed from 言, with 歲 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “Resounding is its sound.”

shuowen:1648.text: Rapid speech. Formed from 言, with 咼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1649.text: To clamor. Formed from 言, with 魋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1650.text: To disturb. Formed from 言, with 喿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1651.text: To shout loudly. Formed from 言, with 丩 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn commentary says: “Someone shouted in Song's great ancestral temple.”

shuowen:1652.text: To howl or call out. Formed from 言 and 虎.

shuowen:1653.text: To clamor. Formed from 言, with 雚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1654.text: To clamor. Formed from 言, with 華 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1655.text: False or reckless speech. Formed from 言, with 雩 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1656.text: False or erroneous words. Formed from 言, with 爲 indicating the sound. The Odes says: “The people's false rumors.”

shuowen:1657.text: To mislead. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 佳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1658.text: Error. Formed from 言, with 吳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1659.text: The reckless words of a mad person. Formed from 言, with 翏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1660.text: Speech in a dream. Formed from 言, with 巟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1661.text: To shout loudly to encourage oneself. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 暴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1662.text: 訬 means disturbance. Another explanation: 訬 means crafty. Formed from 言, with 少 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 毚.

shuowen:1663.text: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 其 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1664.text: Crafty deception. Yi and Liang call it 謬欺; throughout the realm it is called 譎. Formed from 言, with 矞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1665.text: To deceive. Formed from 言, with 乍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1666.text: Deceptive falsehood. Formed from 言, with 于 indicating the sound. Another explanation: 訏 means 𧪰; Qi and Chu call trustworthiness 訏.

shuowen:1667.text: To sigh. Another explanation: pain and regret. Formed from 言, with 差 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1668.text: Speech with breath failing. Another explanation: unceasing. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 龖 indicating the sound. Fu Yi pronounces it like 慴.

shuowen:1669.text: Faltering or fearful speech, 謵讋. Formed from 言, with 習 indicating the sound. [The exact descriptive sense is uncertain.]

shuowen:1670.text: To defame one another. Formed from 言, with 亞 indicating the sound. Another explanation: fear or submission, 畏亞. [The final expression is uncertain.]

shuowen:1671.text: To defame one another. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 隨 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1672.text: Much speech, 嗑. Formed from 言, with 闒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1673.text: To speak or explain. Formed from 言, with 匈 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1674.text: To contend. Formed from 言, with 公 indicating the sound. Also used in 謌訟, songs of praise.

shuowen:1675.text: Anger. Formed from 言, with 眞 indicating the sound. Palace Attendant Jia explains 謓 as laughing. Another explanation gives the pronunciation as 振.

shuowen:1676.text: Much speech. Formed from 言, with 聶 indicating the sound. Hedong has Huniè county.

shuowen:1677.text: To speak loudly in anger. Formed from 言, with 可 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1678.text: To accuse to one's face. Formed from 言, with 臣 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 指.

shuowen:1679.text: To press charges against one another face to face, making accusations. Formed from 言, with 干 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1680.text: To report or accuse. Formed from 言, with abbreviated 厈 indicating the sound. The Analects says: “He accused Zilu before Jisun.”

shuowen:1681.text: To accuse maliciously. Formed from 言, with 朁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1682.text: To slander. Formed from 言, with 毚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1683.text: To rebuke and question. Formed from 言, with 遣 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1684.text: To punish. Formed from 言, with 啻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1685.text: To reproach. Another explanation: to blame one another. Formed from 言, with 耑 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 專.

shuowen:1686.text: To reproach one another. Formed from 言, with 襄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1687.text: To harangue and scold. Formed from 言, with 焦 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 嚼.

shuowen:1688.text: To remonstrate repeatedly. Formed from 言, with 朿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1689.text: To reproach. Formed from 言, with 卒 indicating the sound. The Discourses of the States says: “Reproach Shen Xu.”

shuowen:1690.text: To question. Formed from 言, with 吉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1691.text: To reproach with disappointed expectations. Formed from 言, with 望 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1692.text: To reproach. Formed from 言, with 危 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1693.text: To inform or testify. Formed from 言, with 登 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1694.text: To question and confound, 詰詘. Another explanation: to bend and fold. Formed from 言, with 出 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1695.text: To comfort. Formed from 言, with 夗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1696.text: To discover someone's whereabouts and report them. Formed from 言, with 冋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1697.text: A circulating rumor. Formed from 言, with 夐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1698.text: To criticize harshly. Another explanation: to scold. Formed from 言, with 氐 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1699.text: Who or what. Formed from 言, with 隹 indicating the sound.

shuowen:1700.text: To adorn. Another explanation: to change. Formed from 言, with 革 indicating the sound. Pronounced like 戒.
